reviews.title: Long time owner of one.
reviews.review_text: As someone on a budget, this filled the need. I have used mine mostly for carpentry and have many of the attachments. Other than the standard drill, I made considerable use of the circular saw and impact heads, but also used the router, jig saw and tire inflator (bike tires). This is my second one and it is a newer style than the original. It will do most light and moderate jobs well, but has its limits. The batteries are not the best quality but clones are available on the net. It is a decent tool system for someone who wants one tool for many jobs. I wish it was more durable, but you get what you pay for. I have started investing in other brands such as Dewalt and Ridgid which are very well made. Something that disappointed me about the Matrix is that it uses a sealed, carbon brushed motor. One of the brushes wore out on mine and stopped working. I disassembled it in hope to replace the brushes or motor. I contacted Black and Decker and was given a website that handles all their repairs. After many attempts and very laggy website, I spoke to a real person who told me that even though Black and Decker has them as the repair "go to", they mostly repair Dewalt. They checked their system and found that you can not get replacement parts for a Matrix. You must buy an entire new unit. I did find the manufacturer of the motor but they are in China and their entire site is in Chinese. Their motors do not have the special gear attached to them like the B
